summary: Name raw-terminal attach timeout phases, retry only capability issuance with a bound, and retain content-free attach-failure diagnostics in the TUI's bounded attach.log.

rules.detail: Authorization, capability expiry and terminal incarnation fencing are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Existing peers remain compatible; upgrade timeouts still require manual Ctrl-R because remote cleanup is not acknowledged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond installing the updated binaries.

manual.detail: Non-success terminal outcomes are recorded automatically beside slow.log and exits.log in the existing st3/stui cache directory as bounded attach.log entries. Optional FRACTAL_TUI_ATTACH_TRACE_FILE captures the full content-free attempt lifecycle; see the troubleshooting guide.

recovery.detail: The previous binary remains usable; no persisted store migration or rollback is required.
